It's long been accepted that Branched Chain Amino Acids (BCAA) - leucine, isoleucine and valine - are critically important for stimulating muscle protein synthesis, reducing protein breakdown and preserving muscle glycogen stores. Sometimes it's difficult to get the proper nutrients when you are on the go.
Put them back in your car, your gym bag or your briefcase and fulfill your BCAA necessities wherever you are.

Maximize muscle building
The full muscle-building potential of a GNC product is based on its total nitrogen content - so the more nitrogen a product has, the stronger it will perform. Nitrogen needs increase during training, and if nitrogen levels are low, your body pulls from muscle stores which can result in catabolism, poor performance and longer recovery.
Pro Performance BCAA Complex Chew helps fuel performance anabolism.
